capabilities: Unlock a Bitwarden vault with the master password and decrypt it in-plugin
Browse logins, cards, secure notes, and IDs by type or by folder tree
Search items by name, username, or URL
Copy usernames, passwords, and auto-refreshing TOTP codes
Sync or lock the session against US, EU, or self-hosted servers
disambiguation: View-only: it cannot create, edit, or delete vault items.
extras: Unofficial plugin not affiliated with Bitwarden; not in the community plugin store, so it must be installed manually. Warning: decrypted user key and access token are stored in data.json, which should be kept out of Git.
intentEvidence: 非公式プラグインです。Bitwarden 公式とは関係ありません。
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view password vault entries or copy credentials and 2FA codes without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Obsidian のサイドパネルから Bitwarden の Vault を閲覧できる

requires.name: Bitwarden personal API key (client_id and client_secret)

summary: Read-only side panel that unlocks and browses a Bitwarden vault, with search, quick copy, and TOTP codes, decrypted entirely client-side.
